subject: POC course correction — new primary use case + evaluation checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbusretail.com>, Tom Brooks <t.brooks@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:12 -0800
Subject: Recap + POC outline (post-call) — proposed scope

Hi Elena, Tom,

Thanks for taking the call today. Quick recap and next steps from Redwood:

- Scope (proposed): Chat + search reranking for product discovery; 2 workflows: (1) canonical search assistant; (2) returns routing intent classifier.
- Success criteria: Top-3 rerank CTR uplift >= 8% vs baseline; chat answer accuracy (precision on attribute extraction) >= 86% on pilot prompts; latency p95 < 400ms.
- Timeline: 3-week pilot (data ingest + integration week 1; eval week 2; wrap + decision week 3).
- Owners: Karthik (sales), Ben (SE), Marissa (CS).

Attached: POC-outline-v1.pdf (high-level plan) and mutual action plan.

Next steps:
1) Confirm you want to include returns routing as a secondary use case (you said this looked important).
2) Share a small sample of product catalog and 200 sample returns tickets (anonymized) by end of week.
3) Quick rebaseline call if you want to expand scope — propose Thu 18 Feb 9:00 PT.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: POC-outline-v1.pdf (application/pdf), mutual-action-plan.csv (text/csv)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbusretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@nimbusretail.com>, procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:03 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + POC outline (post-call) — proposed scope

Thanks Karthik — quick note from our side.

We're keen to add returns routing as a must-have (not just secondary). Also asking to split success criteria: accuracy for routing should be >= 90% (we're sensitive to false assignments) and chat generative accuracy can remain at 86%.

On timeline, procurement needs a one-week buffer for compliance review; can we shift start to week of Feb 22 and extend trial to 4 weeks?

We'll provide:
- 300 anonymized return tickets (CSV)
- Small product feed (S3 link) + schema

Tom will coordinate the dataset handoff.

Elena
VP Product, Nimbus Retail

Thanks Elena — confirmed.

I've updated the plan to make returns routing a primary use case and extended the pilot to 4 weeks with a Feb 22 start. Draft timeline attached (rebaseline-proposed-timeline.xlsx).

Proposed ownership and milestones:
- Week 0 (pre-work): Data handoff (Nimbus) + access & test S3 (Tom)
- Week 1: Data ingestion + mapping (Ben)
- Week 2: Model fine-tune/adapter + initial eval (Redwood)
- Week 3: Closed-loop tests with sample user flows (Marissa)
- Week 4: Final metrics, go/no-go decision (Joint)

Can Tom confirm the S3 path and an internal contact for procurement? I'll send updated calendar invites once we lock dates.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + POC outline (post-call) — evaluation metrics

Quick notes on evaluation:

- For returns routing: we'll run stratified validation by reason code; target >=90% precision and recall >=88% on labeled sample.
- For chat: add human-in-the-loop sampling to penalize hallucination; set a soft threshold on factuality score (we'll share suggested prompts).
- Telemetry: we'll add token-level latency, model variant, and confidence score for every request. Please confirm logging retention (default 30 days) or if Nimbus needs longer.

I'll attach an evaluation checklist and example Prompts.csv.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
